watches.name: Salm0n Exclusive Access
watches.description: Why can’t horology be a little bit more playful from time to time? In an industry that typically takes itself very seriously, Studio Underd0g offers a fresh perspective. We’ve used current-day machining techniques to emulate a mid-century vintage silhouette, while integrating a refreshingly modern dial. The varied size of the sub-dials is offset by the branding and movement details, which allows the chronograph seconds hand to pass through uninterrupted. Idiosyncratic, yet balanced. Dimensions: Case dimensions : D38.5mm * W13.6mm (10.8mm excluding crystal) Additional dimensions: 20mm Lug width, 44.5mm Lug to lug Architecture: 3-part case construction Material : 316L Stainless Steel Crystal : Sapphire crystals (Double domed front and flat exhibition back) Lume: Super-LumiNova C3 Water-resistance : 5 ATM Movement type : Sellita Cam-Operated Monopusher Manual Winding SW510 M (Spécial / Elaboré 5 ±5 s/d) beating at a Frequency of 28,800 Vibrations/h and a Power Reserve of 63 Hours. Band : 20mm tapered to 16mm Dial: 2-layer with a metallic radial sunray base dial and coarse dégradé top dial International customers (outside of the UK): For tax and duties information please see the 'shipping details' tab on this page.
